name: Button
summary: Marketing call-to-action buttons for the landing sites. These FOLLOW the product Button contract (aha-button) extended to the marketing register: an extra-large pill CTA with primary, secondary and pink-accent variants, all colour/size/motion bound to the DS Button tokens. On a product surface reuse <aha-button> itself; on a framework-free marketing page paste this anchor form. Replaces the live site's ad-hoc button shadow with the DS elevation token, its outline focus ring with the product component's soft box-shadow ring (--aha-button-focus-ring), and adds the secondary variant's missing hover text-colour and press-border states straight from aha-button.js.
